what_to_run.subset_construction: Stratified toy subset: one pilot item per CQ type, all 24 CQ types eligible [C4]. Ceiling n_toy = 24 is a design ceiling derived from the CQ-type count, NOT an observed sample size; CONTEXT gives no per-type item counts.
arms: A: ontology-grounded path, scored by hardOK [C1]
B: similarity baseline, scored by hardOK [C1]

endpoints.guardrail: SHACL conformance over all emitted edits [C7]
endpoints.traceability: every accepted edit linked to >=1 of the 79 structure evidences across the 7 papers [C6] and to >=1 of the 13 transforms [C5]

what_to_run.pilot_only_disclaimer: 0.875/0.5 [C1], 1.0/0.125 [C2], 0.0156/0.0078 [C3] are prior pilot observations used to place thresholds. They are not the toy-gate result and must not be reported as such.

life_or_death_rule.R1: SHACL conforms=True for 100% of emitted edits [C7]; hard precondition
life_or_death_rule.R4: one-sided exact test p < 0.05 (pilot values 0.0156 and 0.0078 both clear this [C3])

threshold_provenance.0.75: placed between pilot similarity 0.5 and pilot ontology 0.875 [C1]
threshold_provenance.0.25_margin: discounted from the derived pilot gap 0.875-0.5 = 0.375 [C1]
threshold_provenance.0.75_end2end: discounted from pilot end2end 1.0, far above pilot baseline 0.125 [C2]
threshold_provenance.0.05_alpha: conventional; both pilot p-values [C3] are below it

fail_conditions.F5: end2end hardOK < 0.75, or end2end at/below baseline 0.125 (pipeline collapse) [C2]
fail_conditions.F6: Any of the 13 transforms [C5] emits an edit with no ontology grounding or no link to the 79 structure evidences / 7 papers [C6] - traceability break
fail_conditions.F7: hardOK_A or hardOK_B undefined for any arm (unscorable subset)

warn_conditions.W1: Exactly one of R2-R5 missed, with R1 and F6 clean -> escalate to full pilot, no death sentence
warn_conditions.W2: Fewer than all 24 CQ types represented [C4] -> gate VOID (unrun), not FAIL

non_claims: Cannot establish generality beyond the 24 CQ types [C4]
Cannot validate the 13 transforms [C5] individually at toy scale
Cannot confirm which contrast each pilot p-value belongs to [C3]
Does not replace held-out evaluation on unseen non-synthesizable targets
missing_inputs: Sample size n per arm; no counts anywhere in CONTEXT
Mapping of 0.0156 vs 0.0078 to specific contrasts [C3]
Statistical test family and multiple-comparison correction
Per-CQ-type item counts and gold labels across the 24 types [C4]
Operational definition of the hardOK predicate and annotator instructions [C1]
Inter-annotator agreement
Identity, preconditions and postconditions of the 13 transforms [C5]
Distribution of the 79 structure evidences over the 7 papers [C6]
Held-out target list and ground-truth definition of 'non-synthesizable'
Negative controls / decoy targets
Seeds, compute budget, runtime envelope

full_response.verdict_rationale: Gate design is complete and internally consistent with the pilot numbers, but it is not executable as specified: no sample sizes, no per-CQ-type item counts, no hardOK predicate definition, and no transform-level specs are present in CONTEXT. Thresholds are therefore provisional design parameters, not calibrated ones.
